dciCustomSharing.description: Indicates whether the custom sharing rule for document checklist items is enabled for your org (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

deleteDCIWithFiles.description: Indicates whether deletion of document checklist items is enabled for your org (true) or not (false). The default value is false.
